# telnyx_porting_order_activation_jobs (Data Source)

The activation jobs of a porting order.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object whose items are listed.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `porting_order_activation_jobs` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_order_activation_jobs))

<a id="nestedatt--porting_order_activation_jobs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `porting_order_activation_jobs`

Read-Only:

- `activate_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the activation job should be executed. This time should be between some activation window.
- `activation_type` (String) Specifies the type of this activation job
- `activation_windows` (Attributes List) List of allowed activation windows for this activation job (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_order_activation_jobs--activation_windows))
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies this activation job
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `status` (String) Specifies the status of this activation job
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.

<a id="nestedatt--porting_order_activation_jobs--activation_windows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `porting_order_activation_jobs.activation_windows`

Read-Only:

- `end_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the activation window ends
- `start_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the activation window starts
